title: From provider research to an accepted handoff
intro: A proposed growth workflow for Forus: establish the practice and its affiliations, resolve ownership, and give the rep enough evidence to take the next useful step.

records.name: Cedar Specialty Group
records.signal: New office listed on the practice website
records.question: Who coordinates medication access across the new and existing locations?

records.name: Harbor Digestive Care
records.signal: A new location shares a parent practice with an existing CRM account
records.question: Does the current practice owner cover this location too?

records.name: Juniper Skin Partners
records.signal: Two sources disagree on the parent organization
records.question: Which organization owns the practice today?

records.name: Maple Neurology
records.signal: The latest specialty and practice source is stale
records.question: Is the practice specialty and administrative contact still current?

records.name: Willow Arthritis Clinic
records.signal: A practice completed onboarding; first workflow use is not yet recorded
records.question: What is preventing the office team from completing its first workflow?

records.name: Larch Dermatology
records.signal: The practice reached the defined activation milestone
records.question: Which setup step was most useful, and where did the team still need help?

records.name: Elm Specialty Associates
records.signal: An intake record has a practice name but no verified organization identifier
records.question: Which verified practice record should this contact belong to?

records.name: Birch Neurology Group
records.signal: The administrative contact asked to stop prospecting outreach
records.question: Preserve the stop request and let the account owner review any existing relationship.

experiments.name: Practice-specific opening
experiments.hypothesis: A verified practice trigger makes the first conversation more useful.
experiments.primary: Accepted qualified conversations per contacted practice
experiments.allocation: Randomize by practice, not individual contact

experiments.name: Owner acceptance receipt
experiments.hypothesis: An explicit accept-or-return step reduces unattended handoffs.
experiments.treatment: Owner acceptance with reason for returned records
experiments.primary: Accepted handoffs within one business day
experiments.guardrail: Duplicate assignments and rep review burden

experiments.name: First-workflow guidance
experiments.hypothesis: A specific onboarding next step helps a practice reach activation.
experiments.treatment: Office-team checklist for the missing setup step
experiments.primary: Activated practices within a fixed observation window

roadmap.title: Learn the workflow and ship one useful queue
roadmap.body: Shadow growth reps, agree on practice identity and ownership rules, and compare a bounded research-and-handoff pilot with the manual process.
roadmap.measure: Research accuracy, review time and accepted handoffs

roadmap.title: Connect evidence to everyday rep work
roadmap.body: Add a reviewed CRM destination, duplicate protection, error recovery and an owner receipt. Train a small group, collect returned-record reasons and refine the workflow.
roadmap.measure: Repeat usage, duplicate writes and time to an accepted next step

roadmap.title: Measure practice activation and scale what works
roadmap.body: Run a practice-level experiment with an agreed activation event. Separate adoption from outcome, review costs and retire steps that do not help the team.
roadmap.measure: Activated practices, cost per useful action and sustained team adoption
